dog.description_text:
Since I'm a long stay pup, my adoption fee has been reduced! Apply for me today to find out my favorite treats and how you can take me home!

There is an adorable video of me on ACC's Instagram page. Click here to experience the cuteness!

My foster writes:
Are you ready to welcome a bundle of happiness into your life? Look no further, because Cedar is here to steal your heart and fill your days with endless joy! This lovable companion is eagerly waiting to find her forever home, and she's bound to be the perfect addition to any family.

Cedar's incredible demeanor makes her an ideal companion for all your daily adventures. Housebroken and well-mannered, she understands the rules and won't jump up on furniture, ensuring a seamless transition into your home. Her favorite game is a spirited game of tug, and you'll find immense joy in sharing these playful moments with her.

Cedar's crate training adds an extra layer of convenience to her adaptable nature. Whether you're working from home or heading out for errands, she's content and secure in her crate. And speaking of working from home, Cedar is the ultimate coworker. She's more than happy to snooze by your feet as you work, providing both companionship and comfort.

Strolls around the neighborhood are a true delight with Cedar by your side. She approaches walks with a leisurely pace, savoring every moment and taking in all the captivating scents along the way. Her curiosity and appreciation for the world around her are a constant reminder to find joy in life's simple pleasures.
Cedar's endearing qualities have won the hearts of everyone she meets, making her a favorite among shelter volunteers. Her unwavering spirit and genuine affection make her an exceptional companion that's ready to fill your life with happiness.

Don't miss your chance to adopt Cedar and make her a cherished member of your family. Her playful antics, loving nature, and heartwarming presence are sure to bring a smile to your face every day.

Cedar is the ultimate couch potato and professional snuggler. She could spend the whole day curled up next to you while you catch up on your favorite shows or get lost in a good book. She's a total homebody-happy with a couple of short walks, a game of tug, and plenty of treats. She's also housebroken and, despite being a bit of a big girl, does just fine in smaller spaces as long as she's with her people.

She's incredibly loving once she knows you, but she can be a little shy with new people. She needs slow introductions and a little patience, but once she trusts you, she's all in. Cedar tends to feel more comfortable around female-presenting folks
dog.name: Cedar
